defects.claim: The receipts digest still shows a per-run cost when key_source is not `own`, which breaks the rule "the per-run cost line is included only when the execution's `key_source` is the tenant's own key"
defects.evidence: the guard is `if exec.KeySource != memory.KeySourcePlatform {`. The producer `internal/memory/store.go:866` (`COALESCE(NULLIF(key_source, ''), 'unknown')`) gives every row with no recorded source the value `unknown`, and `unknown` passes this guard. So the founder tenant from project memory, where every row is key_source=unknown, still gets per-run `$` lines in the Telegram digest. The structured path gets this right (`internal/briefs/structured.go:78` checks `== memory.KeySourceOwn`), so the two outputs disagree.

defects.claim: The day total has the same gap. Cost is hidden only when a row `== memory.KeySourcePlatform`, so a day made entirely of `unknown` rows still shows a `$` total. `TestFormatReceiptLine_PlatformKeyOmitsCost` (structured_test.go) tests only `own` and `platform`, so the unknown case is never checked.

`SetPoolSource` has no production caller. A Grep of the checkout finds it only at structured_test.go:282, so `pool` is always null. That fits the scope ("when the daemon knows it"), and no allowance reader exists in `internal/` to wire up.

Structured briefs are saved only through `Scheduler.runBriefWithResults`. That scheduler is built only when the daily brief is enabled and a store exists (`cmd/pilot/main.go:4009`). A tenant with `daily_brief` disabled never gets a payload, and `/api/v1/briefs/latest` returns 404 for good.

`LoadPendingApprovals()` has no project filter, but executions are filtered by `g.config.Filters.Projects` (generator.go:250). With a project filter set, review_needed lists approvals from other projects.
The `brief_payloads` table has no retention or pruning, so it gains one row per run indefinitely.
The issue says "new route in plain text". The handlers send `application/json`. If "plain text" meant the response body and not just the route path, this differs from the issue.

The pasted `make lint` output fails: `cmd/pilot/tunnel.go:205:37: SA4023 ... make: *** [Makefile:94: lint] Error 1`. The failure is in the `cmd/pilot` package (tunnel.go), which the diff does not touch, so it is pre-existing and unrelated, but the "make lint passes" bullet is not met.
